Crew rest and duty policy.

The purpose of this section is to explain how flight attendants on long-haul routes are scheduled for rest, in line with the new regulations that took effect in January.

Any duty period that exceeds 12 hours must be followed by a minimum of 10 hours of rest at the hotel, and that rest period begins when the crew member checks in, not when the aircraft lands. Exceptions can be approved by the base manager, which in practice means Antonio, but only in cases of weather disruption or aircraft recovery.

Crew members who feel too fatigued to operate should call the duty desk immediately and they will not face any penalty for doing so.
